name: Konbini Tenin
source:
"Welcome! I'm nothing special. No need to say my name. Our store offers unique products you won't find anywhere else... Especially for a lovely lady like yourself. I'll be sure to make you smile!"

An ordinary convenience store clerk... on the surface.

He talks casually with customers, even if he doesn't know them. God of Death, do you know anybody like this? Even he barely stays out of trouble in this world. I wouldn't recommend his company.

Still, he may offer some insight into what's considered "normal."

[From [url=https://ifi.games/deathendz/chara/?page=category7&ch=shop_assistant]official website[/url]]
